notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, builder, height or staffing in any source read. The two Pastmaps items are commercial descriptions of USGS sheets, not the maps themselves; the 1940-labelled page says published 1961, so the 1940 date may be the survey date rather than the print date. The brief's agency '46N' is a land-survey code, so it is proposed for removal. Searches (2) turned up a TopoQuest entry giving 1820 ft MSL, which was not read. No photos found.
